call.title: Tomato Pasta for Two
call.summary: A simple, fresh tomato pasta ready in 20 minutes.
steps: Bring a large pot of salted water to a boil and cook pasta according to package directions until al dente.
While pasta cooks, heat olive oil in a saucepan over medium heat.
Add minced garlic and sauté for 1 minute until fragrant.
Pour in crushed tomatoes, salt, pepper, and sugar. Stir well.
Simmer sauce for 8-10 minutes, stirring occasionally, until it thickens slightly.
Drain pasta and add to the sauce, tossing to coat evenly.
Tear fresh basil and stir into the pasta.
Divide between two bowls and top with grated Parmesan cheese.

call.title: Tomato Pasta for Two
steps: Heat 2 tablespoons olive oil in a large pan over medium heat.
Add 4 minced garlic cloves and sauté for 1 minute until fragrant.
Pour in one 28-ounce can of crushed tomatoes and stir well.
Add 1 teaspoon dried oregano, salt, and pepper to taste.
Simmer the sauce for 15-20 minutes, stirring occasionally.
Meanwhile, bring a large pot of salted water to a boil.
Add 8 ounces of pasta and cook according to package directions until al dente.
Drain the pasta and add it to the tomato sauce.
Toss gently to coat all pasta with the sauce.
Divide between two bowls and top with fresh basil and grated Parmesan cheese.

props.placeholder: Bring salted water to a boil in a large pot. Add pasta and cook until al dente, about 9–11 minutes. Reserve 1 cup pasta water before draining.
While pasta cooks, heat olive oil in a large skillet over medium heat. Add minced garlic and cook for 1 minute until fragrant, stirring frequently.
Pour in canned tomatoes with their juice, breaking them up slightly with a wooden spoon. Add red pepper flakes if using. Simmer for 10 minutes.
Season tomato sauce with salt and black pepper to taste. If sauce is too thick, add reserved pasta water 1/4 cup at a time.
Add cooked pasta to the sauce and toss gently until well coated, about 1 minute. Tear fresh basil leaves and stir through.
Divide between two bowls and top with grated Parmesan cheese. Serve immediately with crusty bread.

call.title: Tomato Pasta for Two
steps: Bring a large pot of salted water to a boil.
Add 200g of pasta and cook according to package directions until al dente.
While pasta cooks, heat 2 tablespoons of olive oil in a pan over medium heat.
Add 3 cloves of minced garlic and sauté for 1 minute until fragrant.
Pour in 400g of canned crushed tomatoes and stir well.
Add salt, pepper, and 1 teaspoon of dried oregano to taste.
Simmer the sauce for 8-10 minutes, stirring occasionally.
Drain the pasta and add it to the sauce, tossing to coat evenly.
Divide between two plates and top with fresh basil and grated Parmesan cheese.

1. Bring a large pot of salted water to boil. Add spaghetti and cook until al dente (about 9-10 minutes).
2. While pasta cooks, heat olive oil in a pan over medium heat. Add minced garlic and sauté for 1 minute until fragrant.
3. Pour in canned tomatoes (crushed by hand if whole). Season with salt and pepper. Simmer for 10 minutes.
4. Tear fresh basil leaves and stir into sauce in the last minute of cooking.
5. Drain pasta and divide between two bowls. Top with tomato sauce and serve immediately.
